title: Fix sticky LiveSocketClient.isTerminating flag after graceful close / timeout
description:
## Summary
`LiveSocketClient.isTerminating` is set to `true` in `terminate()` and is never reset to `false` in `cleanup()`, `ws.onclose`, `disconnect()`, or the `terminateTimeoutId` fallback. It only resets on the next `connect()` call.

As a result, consumers using `LiveSession.isTerminating` or `LiveSessionController.isTerminating` (e.g., disabling a stop/start voice button or showing "Ending..." / "Closing session..." while terminating) stay permanently stuck in the terminating state after the WebSocket closes.

## Evidence (discovered in `@ghchinoy/livebridge@0.1.1` via `~/projects/refinancier`)
- `ts/live-socket.ts:118` / `:146`: `isTerminating` is initialized to `false` and only reset inside `connect()`.
- `ts/live-socket.ts:265-287` (`terminate()`): sets `this.isTerminating = true` and `this.status = "Disconnecting..."`.
  - If the server closes cleanly (`ws.onclose`, lines 193-207): `describeCloseEvent()` reads `this.isTerminating` (needed to suppress abnormal-close warnings), then calls `this.cleanup()`, `this.options?.onStateChange?.()`, and `this.notifyDisconnect()`. Because `cleanup()` leaves `this.isTerminating = true`, all post-close `onStateChange` / `onDisconnected` callbacks and Lit `requestUpdate()` renders still see `isTerminating === true` alongside `isConnected === false`.
  - If the 15s fallback timer fires (`lines 276-281`) or `terminate()` is called when the socket is not `OPEN` (`lines 282-286`): `this.cleanup()` runs without resetting `this.isTerminating = false` AND without setting `this.status = "Disconnected"`, leaving both `isTerminating === true` and `status === "Disconnecting..."`.
  - If `disconnect()` is called (`lines 295-300`): `this.isTerminating` is also not reset.
- `ts/live-socket.ts:302-318` (`cleanup()`): clears `terminateTimeoutId`, calls `onBeforeTerminate?.()`, and closes/nulls `this.ws`, but does not clear `this.isTerminating`.
- `ts/live-session.ts:140-142` and `ts/lit/live-session-controller.ts:53-55` forward `socket.isTerminating` directly to UI components.

## Reproduction
1. Connect a `LiveSessionController` / `LiveSession` (`mode: "audio"`).
2. Bind a button to `?disabled=${this.live.isTerminating}` and label `${this.live.isTerminating ? "Ending..." : active ? "Stop" : "Start"}`.
3. Call `this.live.terminate()`.
4. Server finishes farewell and closes the WebSocket (`ws.onclose` fires, `isConnected` becomes `false`).
5. Observed: `this.live.isTerminating` remains `true` forever; button remains disabled on "Ending...".
6. Expected: once `ws.onclose` / fallback timeout / `disconnect()` completes cleanup, `isTerminating` is `false` and `status` is `"Disconnected"`.

## Suggested Fix
1. In `ts/live-socket.ts` `cleanup()`: reset `this.isTerminating = false` (note: in `ws.onclose`, `describeCloseEvent()` runs *before* `this.cleanup()`, so normal-close suppression continues to work).
2. In `terminate()` timeout callback (lines 276-281) and non-OPEN `else` branch (lines 282-286): set `this.status = "Disconnected"` before `this.cleanup()` / `onStateChange()`.
3. Add unit tests covering:
   - `terminate()` -> `ws.onclose` resets `isTerminating` to `false` and `status` to `"Disconnected"` while still suppressing abnormal-close warnings.
   - `terminate()` -> fallback timeout resets `isTerminating` to `false` and `status` to `"Disconnected"`.
   - `terminate()` -> `disconnect()` resets `isTerminating` to `false`.
   - Calling `terminate()` when socket is already closed does not leave `isTerminating === true`.
close_reason: Shipped v0.1.2: reset LiveSocketClient.isTerminating and upstreamReady in cleanup(), invoke cleanup() before onWarning in ws.onclose, set status='Disconnected' on terminate() timeout and non-OPEN branches, rebuilt browser/dist/livebridge.esm.js, and added Vitest + Lit LiveSessionController regression tests
